reason: The baseline properties of HfMoTaTiZr are directly supported by E5. However, the key premises that V substitution reduces density while preserving a single-phase BCC structure and retaining high strength are not supported by the cited evidence; E1–E4 discuss different alloy systems (e.g., NbTiAl, CrCoNi, AlNbTaTiVZr) and do not provide data on V substitution in HfMoTaTiZr or its effects on phase stability and strength.
premises: V substitution for Ta reduces density by ~10–15%
V substitution preserves a single-phase BCC solid solution
V provides solid-solution strengthening comparable to Ta, retaining ~1600 MPa RT and ~850 MPa at 1000 °C
Fine-tuning Ta:V ratio maintains phase stability and ductility
As-cast HfMoTaTiZr baseline has density 10.21 g/cm³, RT yield ~1600 MPa, 1000 °C yield ~855 MPa
